第1章(1)

景国，金陵。

此时正值腊月，天寒地冻，大雪纷飞。

天色稍晚，原府上下也和金陵的大街上一样变得静悄悄，除了当值的奴仆，能休息的人都早早钻进了被窝，一边哆嗦着钻进冰凉的被窝，一边叹息着冬天真是难过，期盼着春天早早来临。

原府东侧，隐青居内的一个颇为精致的院落里，此时堂屋内却灯火通明，原府的嫡长孙小姐原嘉宁正坐卧不安地直盯着窗户，糊着厚厚窗纸的窗户此时只映着灯火的摇曳影子，看不到户外的风景。

侍立在原嘉宁身旁的大丫鬟锦心把一个小巧的紫铜暖手炉轻轻放到她的手心，又小心地试了试她的手温，才轻声道：「小姐，天色不早了，外面雪又大，屋里虽有火盆，也着实冷了，不如你先到床上歇息片刻？」

床上有轻软厚实的羽绒被褥，里面早早又放进了暖水炉暖被窝，此时躺进去正舒服。

原嘉宁却摇了摇头，目光又望向垂着厚厚门帘的门口，叹道：「锦英怎么还没回来？」

锦心知道自家小姐就是爱操心，她只要有心事，无论如何也不会去乖乖睡觉，也只好无奈地陪伴小姐翘首等待另外一个大丫鬟锦英的消息。

原嘉宁身为原府第三代子孙中的第一人，是第三代里面名副其实的大姊姊，她下面的弟弟妹妹和堂弟堂妹众多，从小就习惯了照顾幼小、习惯了操心，有时候大家常笑话她，小小年纪就婆婆妈妈，比母亲还爱罗唆，原嘉宁也不以为意，该操心的还是操心。

原嘉宁的母亲云青萝性格较为清冷，且又是原府的嫡长媳，平时威严多过慈爱。人们都说子女往往与父母的性格互补，云青萝清傲，原嘉宁就性格偏温柔，弟弟妹妹虽然爱笑她闹她，实则也更喜欢她，总缠着她不放，真心喜爱她。

这时主仆俩正暗自焦急，外面传来急促的脚步声，原嘉宁立刻站起身，锦心抢先掀开了门帘，见锦英手持着一柄油纸伞，却还是沾了半身雪花地正要走进来，忙道：「哎哟，快在门口抖抖雪，别把寒气都带了进来，小心冻着小姐。」

原嘉宁却不在乎这些细节，只顾盯着锦英焦急地问：「没关系。锦英，他如何了？走了吗？」

锦英放下伞，在锦心的帮助下抖落了身上的积雪，站在门口回答道：「小姐，太子殿下吃了小姐送去的吃食，但是不愿回宫，说是要在这里守一夜，为叶姨娘尽尽心。」

原嘉宁柳眉紧蹙，问：「天这么冷，他要在灵堂里待一夜？那可不冻坏了？我爹就没派人过去？」

锦英摇了摇头，说：「奴婢没有遇到其他人。或许因为太子殿下是微服进府的，并不想见其他人吧。」

原嘉宁又叹了口气，小手捏了几捏，在屋里转了两圈，走到窗子下，听到外面的风声越紧，带着尖利的呼哨声作响，可想而知，后半夜风雪越大就会越冷。

她忍不住了，说：「不行，我要过去看看。他冻坏了事小，连累了爹爹和原府可不麻烦了？」

锦心和锦英对视一眼，暗自好笑，小姐关心太子殿下，却还要找借口，真是的。

原嘉宁虽然性格温柔，但却不软弱，只要她打定主意的事儿，别人怎么劝都劝不动。所以听她这么一说，锦心和锦英就急忙取来了外出的厚袄子和今年新做的狐裘大衣替她穿戴好，又取了暖手炉带着，这才亲自为她打着伞向着院落外走去。

叶姨娘的院子并不在隐青居内，而是位于原府东侧的最东北角，独自成院，颇为宽敞，有自己独立的小花园和假山、游廊，规格其实远远超过普通姨娘的待遇，但因为男主人从未来过这里，所以十几年来一直清冷。

叶姨娘是今日早晨被丫鬟发现无疾而终的，因为她的名分只是一个普通的姨娘，所以只停灵一日一夜，明日就会将她落葬了。

原嘉宁今早听到消息的时候大吃一惊，心底里隐隐有些不安，总觉得叶姨娘的死有点突兀，结果傍晚时她就接到消息，说太子殿下玄渊微服进府来祭拜叶姨娘了。

原嘉宁如今已经知道，叶姨娘虽然名义是父亲原修之的妾室，实则是当今的太子殿下玄渊的生母，她实际上是当今皇帝玄昱的女人，和原修之并无任何瓜葛，只不过当年阴错阳差之下，来原府逃避大婚的皇帝与那时还是原府丫鬟的叶姨娘有了一夜之情，才造成了现在的尴尬局面。

玄渊原本叫原琅，被当做原府的第三代庶长孙抚养长大，他只比原嘉宁晚出生半个月，就一直被原嘉宁当做弟弟对待，两人关系还不错。

五年前，皇帝派了原琅跟随原嘉宁的四叔远赴燕京建造新京城，两年前又将原琅招回金陵，让他入宫，认祖归宗，并正式公布他为皇长子，改名玄渊。

但是皇帝只认了自己的儿子，却并不认儿子的生母，玄昱只对外说玄渊的生母乃普通民女刘氏，已早逝，并没有接叶姨娘入宫，并将玄渊寄养在皇后薛珍的名下，权当做嫡子教养。

这对于玄渊的未来当然有好处，但是谁也不知道玄渊的生母叶姨娘心底会是什么滋味，毕竟自己抚养了十几年的儿子突然就变成了别人的，她这个生母至死也不会被公然承认。她会为了儿子突然之间的平步青云高兴呢，还是会为自己一生的寂寥隐忍不平呢？

但是实际上并没有多少人会在意这样一个小小的女人，更少人关心她的所思所想和喜怒哀乐，而就在原府众人都以为叶姨娘会在原府默默终老时，她却突然去世了。

叶姨娘去世的前一天，身为皇长子的玄渊刚刚被立为太子，要说这之间没有什么蹊跷，就连原嘉宁这样一个不问外事的千金小姐也难以相信。

原嘉宁今晨见到父母时，父亲面色肃穆，神色中却并不感到意外，似乎早已预料到会有此结局，所以办理起叶姨娘的丧事也是井然有序，毫不慌张。

叶姨娘不会葬入原家的坟地，而是会单独落葬到栖玄寺后的一处风水佳地。

原嘉宁看着父母如此，心情直往下沉。

越长大，明白的隐密越多，她越觉得难过。

成人的世界里有太多的利益纠葛和冷酷无情了。

当年原本想偷爬上男主人原修之的床的叶姨娘，大概做梦也不会想到自己会成为皇帝的女人，更加不会妄想若干年后，自己的儿子居然会成为太子吧？

她能苟活这么多年，或许已经是非常幸运。今日之死，也不过是早已注定的结局吧？

任何一个皇帝都不会容许他的污点永远存在世上碍他的眼，尤其当这个污点与他选定的准皇位继承人有关时，就更没有一点点容许她苟活的理由了。

去母立太子，历史上并不乏如此做的皇帝，玄昱不是第一个，相信也不会是最后一个。

原嘉宁主仆三人冒着风雪一路走到叶姨娘所在的院子，院子门口挂着两盏糊上了白纸的灯笼。

原嘉宁情绪复杂地看着那两盏白灯笼，心想这是原府里唯一可见的两盏白灯笼了吧？

身为太子的生母，死后却落得如此凄凉，原嘉宁也不知道该不该叹一声造化弄人。

叶姨娘的灵柩停在堂屋正中，是临时的灵堂，原来屋中的一些物品也都糊了白纸，门口的帘子也换成了白布挂帘，此时在门口守候着的两名身材高大健壮的侍卫，见到原嘉宁主仆三人过来时，都颇为诧异。

Chapter 1(1)

Jingguo, Jinling.

It was the twelfth lunar month, the weather was cold and the ground was snowing heavily.

It was getting late, and the whole Yuan Mansion became as quiet as the streets of Jinling. Except for the slaves on duty, everyone who could rest got into bed early. While shivering and getting into the cold bed, they sighed that winter was really sad and looked forward to the early arrival of spring.

On the east side of the Yuan Mansion, in a rather exquisite courtyard in the Yin Qing Residence, the main room was brightly lit at this time. Miss Yuan Jianing, the eldest daughter of the Yuan Mansion, was sitting uneasily and staring at the window. The windows covered with thick window paper only reflected the swaying shadow of the lights, and could not see the outdoor scenery.

The eldest maid Jin Xin, who was standing next to Yuan Jianing, gently placed a small copper hand warmer in the palm of her hand, and carefully tested the temperature of her hands before saying softly: "Miss, it's getting late, it's snowing heavily outside, and even though there is a brazier in the house, it's really cold. Why don't you go to bed and rest for a while?"

There is a soft and thick duvet on the bed, and a heater has been put in it early to warm the quilt. It is comfortable to lie down in it now.

Yuan Jianing shook his head, looked at the door with a thick curtain, and sighed, "Why hasn't Jinying come back yet?"

Jin Xin knew that her young lady loved to worry. As long as she had something on her mind, she would not go to bed anyway, so she had no choice but to accompany her and wait eagerly for news about the other maid, Jin Ying.

Yuan Jianing is the first of the third generation descendants of Yuan Mansion, and is a veritable eldest sister in the third generation. She has many younger brothers, sisters, and cousins. She has been used to taking care of the younger ones and worrying about them since she was a child. Sometimes people often laugh at her. She is a mother-in-law at a young age, and she is more provocative than her mother. Yuan Jianing does not take it seriously. It is worry that should be worried.

Yuan Jianing's mother, Yun Qingluo, has a relatively cold personality, and she is also the eldest daughter-in-law of Yuan Mansion. She is usually more majestic than loving.People say that children often have complementary personalities to their parents. Yun Qingluo is proud and arrogant, while Yuan Jianing has a gentler personality. Although her younger siblings like to laugh at her and make trouble for her, in fact they also like her more and always pester her. They really love her.

At this time, the master and the servant were secretly anxious. There were rapid footsteps outside. Yuan Jianing stood up immediately. Jin Xin opened the door curtain first, and saw Jinying holding an oil-paper umbrella, but she was still half covered with snowflakes and was about to walk in. She hurriedly said: "Oh, shake the snow at the door quickly, don't bring the cold air in, be careful to freeze the lady."

Yuan Jianing didn't care about these details. He just stared at Jinying and asked anxiously: "It doesn't matter. Jinying, how is he? Is he gone?"

Jinying put down her umbrella, shook off the snow on her body with the help of Jinxin, and stood at the door and replied: "Miss, His Royal Highness ate the food sent by the lady, but he did not want to return to the palace. He said he wanted to stay here all night and devote himself to Aunt Ye."

Yuan Jianing frowned and asked, "It's so cold, why does he have to stay in the mourning hall all night? Isn't it freezing? Didn't my father send anyone over?"

Jinying shook her head and said, "My servant didn't meet anyone else. Maybe it's because His Royal Highness entered the palace incognito and didn't want to see anyone else."

Yuan Jianing sighed again, squeezed a few times with his little hands, walked around the room twice, and walked under the window. He heard the wind outside getting louder and louder, with a sharp whistling sound. It was conceivable that the stronger the wind and snow would be, the colder it would be in the second half of the night.

She couldn't help it anymore and said, "No, I want to go over and have a look. It's not a big deal if he's frozen. Isn't it going to be a big deal if he brings down father and Yuanfu?"

Jin Xin and Jin Ying looked at each other, secretly amused. The young lady cares about His Highness, but she still has to make excuses. It's true.

Although Yuan Jianing has a gentle personality, she is not weak. As long as she makes up her mind about something, no one else can persuade her.So after hearing what she said, Jin Xin and Jin Ying hurriedly got the thick jacket they had gone out and the new fox fur coat made this year and put it on for her. They also got a hand warmer to take with them, and then they personally held an umbrella for her and walked out of the courtyard.

Aunt Ye's yard is not in Yinqing Residence, but is located in the northeastern corner of the east side of the original mansion. It is a separate courtyard and is quite spacious. It has its own independent small garden, rockery, and verandah. Its specifications are actually far better than those of ordinary aunts. However, because the male master has never been here, it has been deserted for more than ten years.

Aunt Ye was found dead by the maid this morning. Because her title was just that of an ordinary aunt, she would only be kept alive for one day and one night, and she would be buried tomorrow.

Yuan Jianing was shocked when she heard the news this morning. She felt a little uneasy in her heart. She always felt that Aunt Ye's death was a bit unexpected. However, in the evening she received news that His Royal Highness Prince Xuan Yuan had come to the mansion incognito to pay homage to Aunt Ye.

Yuan Jianing now knows that although Aunt Ye is nominally the concubine of her father, Yuan Xiuzhi, she is actually the biological mother of the current Crown Prince, Xuan Yuan. She is actually the woman of the current emperor, Xuan Yu, and has nothing to do with Yuan Xiuzhi. It was just that by some mistake, the emperor who came to the Yuan Mansion to escape his wedding had a one-night stand with Aunt Ye, who was still a maid in the Yuan Mansion at that time, which led to the current embarrassing situation.

Xuan Yuan's original name was Yuan Lang, and he was raised as the third-generation eldest grandson of Yuan Mansion. He was only born half a month later than Yuan Jianing, and he was always treated as a younger brother by Yuan Jianing. The two had a good relationship.

Five years ago, the emperor sent Yuan Lang to follow Yuan Jianing's fourth uncle to Yanjing to build a new capital city. Two years ago, he called Yuan Lang back to Jinling, allowed him to enter the palace, recognize his ancestors and return to the clan, and officially announced him as the emperor's eldest son, changing his name to Xuanyuan.

However, the emperor only recognized his son, but not his biological mother. Xuan Yu only told the outside world that Xuan Yuan's biological mother was an ordinary commoner's daughter Liu, who had died young. He did not take Aunt Ye into the palace, and fostered Xuan Yuan under the name of Queen Xue Zhen, and raised him as his legitimate son.

This is of course good for Xuanyuan's future, but no one knows how Xuanyuan's biological mother, Aunt Ye, feels in her heart. After all, the son she has raised for more than ten years suddenly becomes someone else's, and she, the biological mother, will not be publicly recognized until her death.Will she be happy for her son's sudden rise to success, or will she endure the loneliness of her life?

But in fact, not many people cared about such a little woman, and even fewer cared about her thoughts, joys and sorrows. And just when everyone in the Yuan Mansion thought that Aunt Ye would die silently in the Yuan Mansion, she suddenly passed away.

The day before Aunt Ye's death, Xuan Yuan, the eldest son of the emperor, had just been established as the prince. To say that there was nothing strange between this, even Yuan Jianing, a wealthy lady who did not care about foreign affairs, could not believe it.

When Yuan Jianing saw her parents this morning, her father looked solemn but not surprised. He seemed to have expected this outcome, so he handled Aunt Ye's funeral in an orderly manner without any panic.

Aunt Ye will not be buried in the cemetery of her original family, but will be buried alone in a feng shui place behind Qixuan Temple.

Yuan Jianing's heart sank when she saw her parents like this.

The older she gets, the more secrets she understands, and the sadder she feels.

There are too many entangled interests and ruthlessness in the adult world.

Aunt Ye, who originally wanted to sneak into the bed of the male master Yuan Xiuzhi, probably never dreamed that she would become the emperor's woman, let alone dreamed that her son would become the prince a few years later, right?

She may be very lucky to have survived for so many years.Today's death is just a predetermined ending, right?

No emperor would allow his stain to remain in the world forever, especially when the stain was related to his chosen heir to the throne, and there was no reason to allow her to live.

There is no shortage of emperors in history who have done this by removing their mother and establishing a prince. Xuan Yu is not the first, and I believe he will not be the last.

The three former masters and servants of Jianing braved the wind and snow to walk to the yard where Aunt Ye was. Two lanterns covered with white paper hung at the door of the yard.

Yuan Jianing looked at the two white lanterns with complicated emotions, thinking that these were the only two white lanterns visible in Yuan Mansion, right?

As the prince's biological mother, she ended up in such a miserable state after her death. Yuan Jianing didn't know whether to sigh or not.

Aunt Ye's coffin was parked in the middle of the hall, which was a temporary mourning hall. Some of the items in the room were covered with white paper, and the curtains at the door were replaced with white cloth curtains. The two tall and strong guards waiting at the door were quite surprised when they saw the three former masters and servants of Jianing coming over.
